ambiguities.text: EIP-7692 is a meta-EIP that references 15+ component EIPs without providing consolidated technical details
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Technical specifications must be derived from individual component EIPs (3540, 3670, 4200, 4750, 5450, 6206, 7480, 663, 7069, 7620, 7698, 7873, 7834, 7761, 7880, 5920)

ambiguities.text: The relationship between devnet phases (eof-devnet-0, 1, 2) and mainnet activation is unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume devnet phases represent development milestones. Final mainnet activation will include all completed and tested EIPs from all phases.

ambiguities.text: EIP is marked 'Stagnant' as of April 2024, status of ongoing development unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume specifications represent intended behavior regardless of current development status. Monitor for updates.

implicit_assumptions.description: Static validation at deploy time catches all stack-related errors, eliminating runtime stack underflow/overflow
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Runtime stack errors could occur, potentially causing unexpected execution failures or exploitable conditions

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot craft EOF bytecode that passes validation but behaves maliciously at runtime
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validation bypass could allow deployment of contracts with exploitable behavior

implicit_assumptions.description: Legacy contracts will continue to function alongside EOF contracts without compatibility issues
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cross-contract calls between legacy and EOF could fail unexpectedly, breaking existing dApps

implicit_assumptions.description: Tooling (compilers, debuggers, analyzers) will be updated to support EOF format before mainnet activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Developers unable to deploy or debug EOF contracts, limiting adoption
